rationale: Replace the Paper-Agent Committee with Minimal Virtual CSRP while retaining Architecture A and C. The old committee architecture remains in repository history but is no longer part of the active three-way comparison.

architectures.label: Architecture 1 — Functional Virtual Institute
architectures.description: Facilitator coordinates Perspective, Predict, Strategy, External and Decision roles over the same evidence packet.

architectures.label: Architecture 2 — Minimal Virtual CSRP
architectures.description: Research Coordinator → Evidence & Data → optional Analysis & Methods → Synthesis & Decision, with shared institutional memory and a non-agent Quality & Safety Gate.

architectures.label: Architecture 3 — Shared-Knowledge Umbrella
architectures.description: One institutional reasoning agent works directly over the shared evidence workspace; papers remain Paper Skills rather than agents.

main_contrast: Compare three levels/forms of organizational specialization: horizontal role specialization vs sequential process specialization vs centralized shared-knowledge reasoning.
historical_note: Paper-Agent Committee remains implemented for archival and later ablation use but is removed from the active three-architecture pre-pilot.
